occurrences.source_text:
Day was from the date of first dose of CPX-POM administration. Dates are displayed as DDMMMYYYY.
The CPX-POM exposure expressed in days is defined as: (last dose taken date - first dose taken date +1) + 16 days.
The CPX-POM exposure expressed in mg is defined as: sum of all (dose per m^2 x Body Surface Area), using Body Surface Area
calculated at baseline for Cycle 1 and Cycle 2 dose administrations, and calculated on Day 1 of every other treatment cycle
from Cycle 3 dose administration.
